instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures a couple dancing on a scenic mountain peak. On the left, the man in the red striped shirt (R2) stands in profile wearing brown trousers, holding his right arm aloft. On the right, the woman in the yellow cardigan (R1) stands in blue jeans, smiling brightly as she raises her left hand to hold his hand high above them. The background features layers of misty green and blue mountains under a soft, overcast sky with diffused daylight.
